sections_en.text: Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Clean the cubicle with the air blower
Disconnect terminals (2,3) from the relay from the back
Connect the Severker 650 injection set terminals to points (2,3) on the relay from the back

Connect the Stop terminals from the Severker 650 injection set to terminals (4, 5) on the relay from the back (note: connect point 5 to the positive point, red in colour, on the Severker 650 injection set, and connect point 4 to the negative point, blue in colour, on the Severker 650 injection set, without disconnecting terminals (4, 5) on the relay from the back)
Set the injection current to (2 x Setting Value)
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Set the Selector in the Severker injection set to the No. Contact position
Reset the time counter display on the Severker 650 injection set
Set the Severker 650 injection set switch to the (ON Time) position.
Record the relay operating time corresponding to the current (2 Setting Value) (note that the Severker injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates)
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set
Reconnect terminals (2,3) on the relay from the back
Remove the plastic cover from the relay from the front
Reset the relay
Refit the plastic cover on the relay from the front.
Reset the Lock out relay on the cubicle and verify this by hearing the relay sound and the C.B Trip indicator lamp going out

Maintenance Procedures Information System

Document No.: EFR-021-r0a | Equipment: Earth leakage protection device in the 6.3 kV system (51N), 1KC911, ABB
Issued to: New Assiut Generation
Status: APPROVED
Approval date: 13 July 2004 | Procedure: Using the Severker 650 current injection set
Next review date: July 2009
Introduction
The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station "El-Walidia", 2*300 MW, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the test was carried out on 9 February 2004 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed, and approved by the Head of the Sector, Eng. Mohamed Hassan Gomaa.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order.
Fence off the work area and place the necessary warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Open a work order.
Fence off the work area and place the necessary warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Severker 650 current injection set
Severker 650 current injection set
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Test leads
Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out
Clean the cubicle with the air blower | 1.
Disconnect terminals (2,3) from the relay from the back | 2.
Connect the Severker 650 injection set terminals to points (2,3) on the relay from the back | 3.
Connect the Stop terminals from the Severker 650 injection set to terminals (4, 5) on the relay from the back (note: connect point 5 to the positive point, red in colour, on the Severker 650 injection set, and connect point 4 to the negative point, blue in colour, on the Severker 650 injection set, without disconnecting terminals (4, 5) on the relay from the back) | 4.
Set the injection current to (2 x Setting Value) | 5.
Disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 6.
Set the Selector in the Severker injection set to the No. Contact position | 7.
Reset the time counter display on the Severker 650 injection set | 8.
Set the Severker 650 injection set switch to the (ON Time) position. | 9.
Record the relay operating time corresponding to the current (2 Setting Value) (note that the Severker injection set disconnects automatically after the relay operates) | 10.
Reduce the current value to zero, then disconnect the Severker 650 injection set | 11.
Reconnect terminals (2,3) on the relay from the back | 12.
Remove the plastic cover from the relay from the front | 13.
Reset the relay | 14.
Refit the plastic cover on the relay from the front. | 15.
Reset the Lock out relay on the cubicle and verify this by hearing the relay sound and the C.B Trip indicator lamp going out | 16.
